import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(sc.nextLine().trim());

        int[] a_list = Arrays.stream(sc.nextLine().trim().split(" "))
                             .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();
        int[] b_list = Arrays.stream(sc.nextLine().trim().split(" "))
                             .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();

        int[] a_backup = a_list.clone();
        int[] b_backup = b_list.clone();

        int maxWins = calculateMaxWins(a_list, b_list);
        int maxLosses = calculateMaxLosses(a_backup, b_backup);

        System.out.println((n - maxLosses) + " " + maxWins);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static int calculateMaxWins(int[] a, int[] b) {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int opponentIdx = (i + 1) % 3;
            int wins = Math.min(a[i], b[opponentIdx]);
            a[i] -= wins;
            b[opponentIdx] -= wins;
            total += wins;
        }
        return total;
    }

    private static int calculateMaxLosses(int[] a, int[] b) {
        int[][] moveOptions = { {0, 2}, {1, 0}, {2, 1}, {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {2, 2} };
        List<int[][]> permutations = generatePermutations(moveOptions);
        int maxLossValue = 0;

        for (int[][] perm : permutations) {
            int[] a_temp = a.clone();
            int[] b_temp = b.clone();
            int[] losses = {0, 0, 0};
            for (int[] move : perm) {
                int loss_amount = Math.min(a_temp[move[0]], b_temp[move[1]]);
                a_temp[move[0]] -= loss_amount;
                b_temp[move[1]] -= loss_amount;
                losses[move[0]] += loss_amount;
            }
            int total_loss = Arrays.stream(losses).sum();
            if (total_loss > maxLossValue) {
                maxLossValue = total_loss;
            }
        }
        return maxLossValue;
    }

    private static List<int[][]> generatePermutations(int[][] moveOptions) {
        List<int[][]> perms = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(moveOptions, 0, perms);
        return perms;
    }

    private static void permute(int[][] arr, int index, List<int[][]> perms) {
        if (index == arr.length) {
            int[][] copy = new int[arr.length][2];
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                copy[i][0] = arr[i][0];
                copy[i][1] = arr[i][1];
            }
            perms.add(copy);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = index; i < arr.length; i++) {
            swap(arr, i, index);
            permute(arr, index + 1, perms);
            swap(arr, i, index);
        }
    }

    private static void swap(int[][] arr, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
    }
}
